name: Shimei
bio: Shimei son of Gera was a Benjamite from Saul's clan who came out cursing David as he fled Jerusalem during Absalom's rebellion, pelting him and his officials with stones and shouting, "Get out, get out, you murderer, you scoundrel! The LORD has repaid you for all the blood you shed in the house of Saul, in whose place you have reigned, and the LORD has given the kingdom into the hands of your son Absalom" (2 Samuel 16:5-8). Abishai wanted to go over and cut off his head, but David refused, saying that if his own son sought his life, this Benjamite's cursing was nothing to stop, and that the LORD might yet see his affliction and repay him with good for the cursing he endured that day (2 Samuel 16:9-13). Shimei continued cursing, throwing stones, and flinging dust at David all along the road. His later reckoning with David, when David returns to Jerusalem and eventually when Solomon takes the throne, is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
